entries.sense_en: fond of causing trouble and playing unkind tricks on people

synonyms.nuance: Mostly used for children who misbehave; milder and less clever than mischievous.
Fun and harmless; mischievous suggests some trouble or unkindness.
Much stronger: truly evil, though in speech it can also mean playfully bad.

entries.sense_en: made to look bigger or worse than it really is

synonyms.nuance: Describe something as bigger or worse than it is, usually in words rather than by sight.
Neutral: simply make bigger, often a photo or a space.
Make stronger or louder, especially sound, signals or feelings.

entries.sense_en: twisted out of its natural shape

synonyms.nuance: Bend out of shape, usually wood or something flat, because of heat or damp.
Change the shape permanently; often used for bodies and medical or technical contexts.
Everyday and general; distort stresses a wrong, unnatural result.

entries.sense_en: a tiny sharp piece broken off from glass or wood

synonyms.nuance: A long, thin piece cut or broken off; stresses thinness rather than a sharp point.
A broken piece of glass or pottery, usually larger and more jagged.
General word for any broken piece, with no idea of sharpness.

entries.sense_en: to shake suddenly with fear or disgust

synonyms.nuance: Shake from cold or fear; more common and often from cold, while shudder is a stronger single jerk.
Shake gently and continuously, from fear, weakness or emotion.
Tiny, quick trembling, often of a voice or lip.

entries.sense_en: amused and pleased him
entries.sense_ko: 그의 마음을 즐겁게 하다, 흥을 돋우다

synonyms.nuance: Make someone smile or laugh; lighter and more general.
Be attractive to someone's taste; no idea of laughing.
Attract you suddenly, especially something you want to buy or do.
synonyms.example: a hat that took her fancy

entries.tip_ko: fancy는 여기서 '변덕스러운 취향, 마음의 흥'이라는 뜻입니다.

entries.sense_en: accept something modest and not ask for more

synonyms.nuance: Get by with something less than ideal; more casual and practical.
Accept less than you wanted, usually with some disappointment.
Plain and neutral; no hint of settling for less.

entries.sense_en: a small, poor room just under the roof of a house

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word: the space under the roof, mainly for storage.
An upper space under a roof, or a converted one for living or working.

entries.sense_en: a channel along a roof edge that carries rainwater away

synonyms.nuance: Any pipe or channel that takes water away, not only from a roof.
The lower edge of a roof that sticks out; the gutter is fixed under it.
A channel dug in the ground, not part of a building.

entries.tip_ko: 길가의 배수로도 gutter라고 하며, 비유로 '밑바닥 삶'을 뜻하기도 합니다.

entries.sense_en: a thin curling shoot by which a climbing plant holds on

synonyms.nuance: Any new growth from a plant; it need not curl or cling.
The whole climbing plant, not the small curling part.
General shape of something curved, such as hair or smoke.

entries.sense_en: like the grand arch built to celebrate a victory (a triumphal arch)

synonyms.nuance: Having actually won; triumphant also describes the proud feeling or look of winning.
Loudly happy because of success; stresses joyful celebration.
Very proud and delighted; more formal and literary.

entries.tip_ko: '개선문'은 오늘날 triumphal arch라고 하며, triumphant는 보통 '의기양양한'이라는 뜻입니다.

entries.sense_en: an old British coin worth a quarter of a penny

synonyms.nuance: A more valuable coin (four farthings); still used today.
Worth two farthings; another old small British coin.

entries.sense_en: flying together in a large moving crowd
entries.sense_ko: 떼 지어 날아다니다, 무리 지어 움직이다

synonyms.nuance: Used for birds or sheep; a calmer, more orderly group.
Be full of moving creatures; the place is the subject.
A big crowd of people pressing together.

entries.sense_en: amazing and beautiful, almost magical

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word for very good; wondrous is literary and suggests magic or awe.
Causing great admiration; a little old-fashioned in speech.
Seeming to need a miracle; suggests something impossible happened.

entries.sense_en: very thin, light cloth that you can almost see through

synonyms.nuance: A thin cotton cloth, slightly firmer than gauze.
Cloth with an open pattern of holes, used for decoration.
A thin cloth worn over the face or head, or a thin cover.

entries.sense_en: so bright it almost hurts the eyes

synonyms.nuance: Very bright or very clever; less likely to hurt the eyes.
Harsh and unpleasant bright light.
So bright you temporarily cannot see; stronger than dazzling.

entries.sense_en: calm rest; a peaceful, still state

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word for stopping activity or sleeping.
A state free of noise, worry or movement, not a time of resting.
Freedom from trouble or disturbance; broader than repose.

entries.sense_en: signaled with a hand for someone to come closer

synonyms.nuance: Move the hand to and fro to greet or say goodbye, not to call someone near.
Make a hand signal to tell someone to do something.
Order someone to come, often formally or with authority.

entries.sense_en: not usual; more than was normal

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word for not common.
Not often found; a bit more formal than unusual.
Not used to something, or not customary; slightly formal.

entries.tip_ko: wonted(늘 하던, 익숙한)에 un-이 붙은 말이며, 현대 영어에서는 거의 문어체에만 쓰입니다.

entries.sense_en: eaten away by a plant disease or rot

synonyms.nuance: Decayed and bad, used for fruit, wood and more.
Ill with a disease; general and clinical.
Damaged by a plant disease or spoiled by bad luck.

entries.sense_en: hurried away

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word; hasten sounds more formal or literary.
Move very fast, often too fast; more urgent and less careful.
Run with short quick steps, like a small animal.

entries.sense_en: the particular way a person walks

synonyms.nuance: A long, firm step, or the way one takes such steps.
Everyday word; can be the act of walking or a way of walking.
The speed of walking or running, not its style.

entries.sense_en: to make fun of someone in an annoying, unkind way

synonyms.nuance: Make fun of someone with contempt; harsher and never friendly.
Say cruel things on purpose to make someone angry or upset.
Casual, friendly joking; not meant to hurt.

entries.tip_ko: 친구 사이의 장난이면 가볍고, 여기서처럼 상대를 아프게 하면 나쁜 뜻이 됩니다.

entries.sense_en: shouted very loudly and roughly

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word for speaking very loudly.
Loud and sharp, often from anger or excitement.
A deep, powerful roar, like a bull.

entries.tip_ko: 'bawl'은 크게 울다는 뜻도 있습니다 (bawl one's eyes out).

entries.sense_en: a small vehicle on runners that slides over snow

synonyms.nuance: The usual American word for a small sledge used for play.
A bigger sledge pulled by horses or reindeer, carrying people.
A long, low sledge without runners for sliding downhill.

entries.sense_en: useless; not able to help at all

synonyms.nuance: One word, same meaning; more direct and common.
Has no purpose or result; about an action, not a tool.
Without success after an effort, and used with verbs.

entries.sense_en: a sudden sharp movement

synonyms.nuance: A rough shake caused by a bump or shock.
synonyms.example: a jolt on the bumpy road

synonyms.nuance: A sudden unsteady move to one side or forward.
A quick pull on something.

entries.sense_en: pleasant and suitable; agreeable to him

synonyms.nuance: Pleasant and easy to accept; a bit formal.
Everyday word for enjoyable, without the sense of being suited to someone.
Describes people who are kind and welcoming; congenial can also describe places.

entries.tip_ko: 여기서는 '사람이 친절한'이 아니라 '그에게 잘 맞는'이란 뜻입니다.

entries.sense_en: made a long, low, sad sound

synonyms.nuance: A deeper, heavier sound of pain or annoyance.
A long, high, loud cry of grief.
A long, loud, wild cry, like a wolf or strong wind.

entries.sense_en: dark, gloomy and depressing

synonyms.nuance: Dark or sad; the most common everyday word.
Dull, grey and boring as well as sad.
Empty, cold and without hope.

entries.sense_en: climbed awkwardly using hands and feet

synonyms.nuance: Move quickly and awkwardly over rough ground or up something.
Neutral word; may be easy and graceful.
Move on hands and knees or very slowly.

entries.sense_en: very old and respected
entries.sense_ko: 나이 들어 존경할 만한, 유서 깊은

synonyms.nuance: Very old, with no idea of respect.
Deeply respected by many people, whatever the age.
Plain word; venerable adds dignity from age.

entries.sense_en: stood guard at a place

synonyms.nuance: The everyday form; used for soldiers and any protector.
Look out for danger; can be done sitting.
Walk around an area to guard it instead of staying in one place.

entries.sense_en: magic done by a witch

synonyms.nuance: Magic using evil spirits; more serious and sinister.
The general word, for good or bad and also for tricks.
A spell that charms, or the charmed feeling itself.

entries.sense_en: a light cover laid over a bed
entries.sense_ko: 침대 덮개, 이불 위에 덮는 얇은 담요

synonyms.nuance: The modern word for a decorative cover over the whole bed.
A padded cover with stitched patterns, warmer than a coverlet.
A warm cover for sleeping under; not decorative.

entries.sense_en: sounding sad and sorrowful, like a soft cry

synonyms.nuance: Full of grief for a loss.
Sad, and often showing the feeling openly.
Sad because of longing for something past or out of reach.

entries.sense_en: light and lively, as if floating

synonyms.nuance: Happy and in a good mood, without the sense of lightness.
Full of energy and movement.
Weighing little; buoyant adds the idea of floating up.

entries.sense_en: feels that something is worthless or beneath her

synonyms.nuance: Treat as worthless, often openly and with mockery.
Strong dislike or anger; despise means looking down on someone.
Cold, proud contempt; more formal and literary.

entries.sense_en: gave an unpleasant sharp feeling in the teeth, here from very sour fruit

synonyms.nuance: Cause a quick pained expression; not just teeth.
synonyms.example: The sour taste made her wince.

synonyms.nuance: Annoy again and again, especially a sound.
Make you feel uneasy or scared.
synonyms.example: That house gives me the creeps.

entries.tip_ko: 칠판 긁는 소리처럼 불쾌한 소리·맛에도 씁니다.

entries.sense_en: cold, grey and sad

synonyms.nuance: Gloomy and depressing; a little stronger.
Boring, with no color or interest.
Plain and colorless, without brightness.

entries.sense_en: free and allowed to do something

synonyms.nuance: Everyday way to say you are allowed to do something.
Officially allowed, with no idea of choice.
Having a right to something.

entries.tip_ko: 'at liberty to'는 격식 있는 표현으로 오늘날에는 'free to'를 씁니다.

entries.sense_en: in such a way

synonyms.nuance: The everyday form of the same meaning.
synonyms.example: He spoke in such a way that all listened.

synonyms.nuance: Casual and short.

entries.sense_en: embarrassed and uneasy, feeling small

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word for feeling awkward in front of others.
Feeling guilt over something you did wrong.
Slightly embarrassed after a small mistake.

entries.sense_en: a dreamlike state in which you do not notice what is around you

synonyms.nuance: Confused and unable to think clearly, often after a shock.
Almost unconscious, from drink, drugs or shock.
A magic charm that puts someone under control.

entries.sense_en: chandeliers, glass ornaments hung from a ceiling

synonyms.nuance: The usual word for a hanging branched light with crystals.
A large branched holder for candles, usually standing rather than hanging.
Soft shine on a surface — the usual modern meaning of lustre, not the one here.

entries.tip_ko: 여기서는 '광택'이 아니라 옛 뜻 '샹들리에'입니다. 미국식 철자는 luster.

entries.sense_en: in a proud way that looks down on others

synonyms.nuance: Acting as if you are better; suggests bad behavior.
Can be positive (pride in success); haughtily is always negative.
Casual and mocking; a snobbish attitude.

entries.sense_en: remembered something

synonyms.nuance: Bring a memory back on purpose; slightly formal.
The plain everyday word.
Casual; the thought just comes to you.

entries.sense_en: said (a farewell)

synonyms.nuance: Plain word; bade is fixed to phrases like bade farewell.
Expressed a hope, as in wished her good luck.

entries.tip_ko: bid의 과거형 bade는 /bæd/(배드) 또는 /beɪd/로 읽으며 'bid farewell'로만 남았습니다.

entries.sense_en: from a long way off

synonyms.nuance: Everyday phrase for the same idea.
Plain; describes distance, in speech and writing.
Describes where something appears, at a far point.

entries.sense_en: pleasantly round and well fed

synonyms.nuance: Round and cute; usually for children's faces and cheeks.
Blunt and often rude when about people.
Heavy and solid in build, often an older man.

entries.sense_en: insisting on doing what she wants, ignoring advice

synonyms.nuance: Refusing to change one's mind, even when wrong.
Deliberately doing what you want against orders.
Formal and stronger; refusing to change.

entries.sense_en: the natural color and look of the skin, especially the face

synonyms.nuance: The color of skin only; the modern everyday phrase.
Skin, hair and eye colors taken together.
General appearance, not just skin.

entries.sense_en: a way out

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word for the way out.
A place where something like smoke or water flows out.
Casual and clear.

entries.tip_ko: ingress(입구)의 반대말이며 주로 법·건축 문서에 쓰입니다.

entries.sense_en: a very large metal pot for boiling over a fire

synonyms.nuance: The usual modern spelling of the same word.
A smaller pot with a spout, for boiling water.
General cooking vessel; smaller than a caldron.

entries.sense_en: tied to one spot with a rope

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word for fastening with a rope or string.
Fastened with metal links; stronger than a rope.
Held on a short lead, especially dogs.

entries.sense_en: the place where someone lives

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word, with warm feelings.
Formal word for any place to live in.
Official or formal word for where one lives.

entries.sense_en: a large mouthful of a drink swallowed at once
entries.sense_ko: (한 번에 들이켜는) 한 모금, 한 잔

synonyms.nuance: A quick, large swallow, often noisy.
Casual: a big mouthful straight from the bottle.
A very small taste; the opposite of a draught.

entries.sense_en: a step taken in advance to avoid danger or trouble

synonyms.nuance: A rule or device that protects; a lasting protection.
Careful behavior in general, not one specific step.
Any action taken for a purpose, not only for safety.

entries.sense_en: worrying and being unhappy about something

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word for anxious thoughts.
Think sadly about something for a long time.
Feel sad by longing for someone or something gone.

entries.sense_en: from memory, word for word

synonyms.nuance: Without looking; not necessarily word for word.
Learned by repetition without real understanding.
Same idea; a British variation.
synonyms.example: know the song off by heart

entries.tip_ko: know/learn ... by heart 형태로 쓰며, 영국식은 off by heart도 씁니다.

entries.sense_en: defeat completely

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word for beating an opponent.
Win by taking control of a place, or overcome a difficulty.
Defeat by force so completely that no fight remains.

entries.sense_en: sweat

synonyms.nuance: The everyday word; perspiration is more polite and formal.
Wetness in general, not only from the body.

entries.sense_en: in a begging way, wanting help very much

synonyms.nuance: Asking with strong emotion; nearly identical but plainer.
Very literary; deeper and more anxious.
With no hope left, stressing the urgency.

entries.sense_en: causing great fear

synonyms.nuance: The modern word for frightening.
Looking so dangerous that people fear it.
Very bad or awful, and frightening.

entries.tip_ko: 현대 영어의 terrific은 보통 '훌륭한'이라는 뜻이라 여기서는 옛 뜻임에 주의하세요.

entries.sense_en: a large army or a huge crowd

synonyms.nuance: A large armed force; legion also means a big group.
A great number; a literary word.
A very large crowd or number.

entries.sense_en: shining brilliantly and looking magnificent

synonyms.nuance: Very fine and impressive; not necessarily shining.
Grand and impressive in size or beauty.
Shining brightly and cleanly.

entries.sense_en: very skillful at making things

synonyms.nuance: Has great ability in doing something; no trace of trickery.
Clever at inventing new ways.
Secretly tricky, in the modern sense of cunning.

entries.tip_ko: 현대 영어의 cunning은 보통 '교활한'이지만, 여기서는 옛 뜻 '솜씨 좋은'입니다.

entries.sense_en: made unable to feel or move, usually by cold

synonyms.nuance: Everyday adjective for no feeling.
Very cold, or unable to move from fear.
Unable to move at all; often from illness or shock.

entries.sense_en: the chest, seen as the place of feeling

synonyms.nuance: The plain body part in front of the ribs.
Literary for the chest, as the place of feelings.
The emotional center, not the body part.
synonyms.example: from the bottom of my heart

entries.sense_en: melted the ice

synonyms.nuance: General word for turning from solid to liquid.
Remove ice from frozen food or a fridge.
Make something no longer frozen; less common.

entries.sense_en: a young unmarried woman

synonyms.nuance: A young unmarried woman in old tales.
Everyday word.
A polite word for a woman of good manners.

entries.tip_ko: 'damsel in distress'(위기에 처한 아가씨)로 자주 씁니다.

entries.sense_en: cries out and shows deep sadness

synonyms.nuance: Feel and show sadness for a death.
Feel deep sorrow, often quietly.
Cry out loudly about a loss.

entries.sense_en: in a way that makes people feel pity

synonyms.nuance: The common word; can also mean badly or weakly.
Sad, or sometimes sadly weak.
With grief, without asking for pity.

entries.sense_en: fresh green plants and leaves

synonyms.nuance: The everyday word for green leaves and plants.
All the leaves of a plant, whether green or not.
All plant life in an area, neutral and scientific.
